conditions.label: Arousal
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's arousal is at or above {param1}%.

conditions.label: Days Since Orgasm
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor has gone without orgasm for at least {param1} day(s).

conditions.label: Exposure Rate
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's arousal is climbing at least {param1} per check.

conditions.label: Arousal Locked
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's arousal is {param1}.

effects.label: Arousal Rate
effects.description: Steadily raises the actor's arousal by {param1}% every in-game hour while active.

param1.label: Exposure delta on self per game-hour

effects.label: NPC Arousal Rate
effects.description: Pheromone aura — steadily raises the arousal of nearby NPCs by {param1}% every in-game hour while active.

param1.label: Exposure delta on nearby NPCs per game-hour

effects.label: Modify Arousal
effects.description: Burst — adds {param1}% to the actor's arousal when the tier activates.

param1.label: Burst exposure added to self on switch

effects.label: Set Exposure Rate
effects.description: Sets the actor's arousal-climb speed to {param1} while active, then restores the previous value on deactivate.

effects.label: Trigger Orgasm
effects.description: Burst — resets the actor's 'days since orgasm' counter to zero when the tier activates.
